messages:
alex: heads-up — starting canary deploy v2.14 to eu-west at 30% traffic. running preflight, will update.

deploy-bot: Automated: release=v2.14 stage=canary region=eu-west traffic=30% commit=fa3b1c preflight=[metrics,traces,kvcache]

maya: grabbing Watchtower panel https://dash.redwood.ai/watchtower/eu-west?from=now-15m

jamal: seeing p95 for embed-route trending up: baseline ~120ms -> 420ms in last 3m

lina: small bump in proxy 502s (+0.3%) around the same time, sampling traces now

srebot: ALERT (low): slo.embed-route.p95 crossing threshold (rule=slo-embed-95). tagging thread.

alex: hold ramp at 30% for now. can someone check kvcache evictions and prefix cache hit rate?

maya: kvcache evictions spiked ~3x at 20:35. prefix-hit dropped from 68% -> 55% during canary window.

jamal: traces show requests with longer contexts hitting quantize-v2 path — a few pods show OOM throttles + retry churn.

lina: suggests pinning canary traffic back to v2.13 while we investigate quantize-v2 behavior.

alex: decision: do a canary-only pin to v2.13 and keep traffic at 30% until metrics stabilize. who can run the pin?

maya: i'll do it. running pin now:

```bash
./deployctl pin --service embed-service --version v2.13 --scope canary
```

deploy-bot: Received pin request from maya. applying pin -> v2.13 (canary). estimated propagation ~25s.

ops-runbook: Runbook excerpt: step 4 — if p95 > 300ms AND 5xx delta > 0.2% THEN hold + pin. https://runbooks.redwood.ai/deploys/canary-pin

srebot: Suppressing alert slo-embed-95 for 10m while pin propagates. :white_check_mark:

maya: pin applied. canary routing now pinned to v2.13. initiating warmpool prefetch to rebuild prefix cache.

jamal: observing 5xx rate dropping and p95 falling back toward baseline (~130ms). looks like win.

lina: adding a quick note to the release thread: probable root cause = quantize-v2 path + long-context requests -> cache churn.

alex: thanks. we'll keep the canary paused at 30% for 30m and watch. if stable, resume ramp. release note snippet: "paused canary ramp due to transient embed-route latency; pinned canary to v2.13 while investigating."

maya: noted and logging follow-up ticket for quantize-v2 investigation. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Status update: canary paused, pinned=v2.13, alerts muted. closing loop unless new signals arrive.
